# E017 -- Uber Brand System Quick Guide

## Metadata
- **Company:** Uber
- **Industry:** Transportation
- **Year:** 2018
- **Source file:** Uber_2018.pdf
- **Pages:** 10
- **Language:** EN
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 9-10 (plus 3-5, 8 due to short document)

## Brand Strategy
- "Brand System Quick Guide" -- designed for Uber's partner and sponsor ecosystem
- Purpose: safeguard brand in partnership environments, provide correct assets
- All partner-led creatives must be pre-approved by Uber brand team
- Positioning as "global leader in multi-modal transportation"

## Logo
- Black on lighter backgrounds, white on darker backgrounds
- Clearspace: equal to cap height of the "U"
- Three lockup types: vertical, horizontal, product
- Partnership lockup: follows clear space rules; separator line created via vertical line glyph in Uber Move Display Light at logo size
- Product lockup with spacing and alignment guidance

## Typography
- Uber Move -- proprietary brand typeface, described as "key element in our brand"
- Two variants:
  - Uber Move Display: headlines and sub-headlines (Light, Regular, Medium, Bold)
  - Uber Move Text: body copy (Light, Regular, Medium, Bold)
- Pairing rules: Medium + Light OR Bold + Regular (no mixing)
- Headline: Uber Move Display Medium, 6+ words, 1.5x logo point size minimum, 1.0 leading, 0 tracking
- Subhead: Uber Move Display Light, 1/2 headline size, 1.2 leading, 0 tracking
- Logo height equals composition margin width
- CTAs: Uber Move Text Bold for actions, Uber Move Display Bold for buttons

## Color
- Primary: White (FFFFFF) and Black (000000, CMYK 70 35 40 100, PMS Black 6 C)
- Safety Blue: R39 G110 B241 / HEX 276EF1 / PMS 2174 C -- unique to Uber, used sparingly for "support, assurance, and delight"
- Secondary colors "from the colors of transportation" (used sparingly in illustration, photography, product):
  - Uber Green: HEX 47B275 / PMS 2416 C
  - Uber Yellow: HEX FFC043 / PMS 135 C
  - Uber Red: HEX F25138 / PMS 7417 C (note: listed as F25138, text says E64C35 in RGB)
  - Uber Brown: HEX 99644C / PMS 7525 C
  - Uber Orange: HEX FF7D49 / PMS 164 C
  - Uber Purple: HEX 7356BF / PMS 2102 C
- Usage proportions defined: white provides balance with black; secondary colors used sparingly
- Full RGB + CMYK + HEX + PMS specifications for all colors

## Graphics
- Not covered in this quick guide

## Photography
- Not covered in this quick guide (secondary colors mentioned for photography use)

## Applications
- Partnership lockups, product lockups
- CTA design (action links and buttons)
- All assets available via Google Drive links (logo, lockups, color, typography)

## Tone of Voice
- Not covered in this quick guide
- Functional, direct language in the guide itself

## Outliers
- Very concise: 10 pages covering logo, color, typography, and assets only
- "Safety Blue" is a notable concept -- a color reserved for trust/safety moments in user interaction
- Proprietary typeface (Uber Move) with Display and Text variants -- significant brand investment
- Secondary colors named by Uber prefix (Uber Green, Uber Yellow, etc.) -- ownership of color
- CMYK for black is not pure K (70 35 40 100) -- rich black specification
- Google Drive asset links included -- practical but ephemeral (likely outdated by now)
- Partner/sponsor-focused guide rather than internal brand bible -- external-facing simplification
- Proportional usage rules suggest a design system approach

## Quality Score
- **Score: 3/5** -- Effective quick-reference guide for partners. Strong fundamentals: proprietary typeface with clear pairing rules, well-specified color system with Safety Blue concept, practical logo guidelines. However, it is intentionally minimal (10 pages) and omits photography, graphics, tone of voice, and applications depth. The Google Drive asset links are a practical touch. Good for its purpose as a partner quick guide but not a comprehensive brand system.
